# Trainers

The training loop that updates the model. ``backpropagation`` is standard gradient descent. The Mono-Forward profiles share one training math - each layer trains locally against a per-layer projection matrix, with O(1) activation memory in depth - and differ only in worker backend.

Namespace: ``registry.namespace("trainers")``, declared in ``praxis.trainers`` (3 entries)

Selected with ``--trainer-type`` (default: ``backpropagation``).

## `backpropagation` - BackpropagationTrainer

A standard backpropagation training module with automatic torch.compile support.

Source: [praxis/trainers/backpropagation.py:18](../praxis/trainers/backpropagation.py#L18)

## `mono_forward`

Mono-Forward in process: every layer runs in the driver process under one CUDA context,
on a single host. The default Mono-Forward profile, with no Ray dependency and low VRAM
overhead, for iterating on very deep models on one GPU.

## `mono_forward_ray`

Mono-Forward with one Ray actor per layer. Multi-host capable, but each actor pays
roughly 300-500 MB of CUDA context, so it is the profile for runs that need multiple
machines.
